normalized.description: The Dutch Satellite Data Portal provides high resolution satellite data to users in the Netherlands since 2012. These data may be used freely by registered users. Part of the data portfolio consists of (high resolution) radar data. These data are used by various users for different applications, of which ground motion (InSAR) is currently the most prominent use case. The satellite data portal has developed into an important platform in the Netherlands for access to high resolution satellite data in support of space applications. Data continuity is an important aspect in providing a reliable data source.
